spec_match.rationale: The comma rule's second branch is now a real container-query feature, style(--boost: on), instead of (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) which is an unknown query inside @container and always evaluates false. Single-condition baseline rules sit beneath it so no frame is ever blank.

interactive.rationale: Show-all / hide-≥360 toggles, a --boost flag toggle driving the style() axis, and a conditionText reader; all operate on the five real fixed-width container frames.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb now says the rule mixes a size branch and a style() branch — matching what the CSS actually does — and the 360px frame is labelled 'trigger' and genuinely reaches its breakpoint.

edge_cases.rationale: Capability detection shows a 'needs Chrome 150+' note when the comma rule is dropped; the conditionText reader distinguishes a parsed comma rule from only single-condition rules; fixed-width frames scroll inside their cards rather than forcing page overflow.

conformance.rationale: Aligned with the feature suite's comma-list parse / conditionText contracts.
